Combine micropubr plots into a labelled multi-panel figure

Source: R/mp_combine.R
mp_combine.Rd

A thin convenience wrapper around patchwork::wrap_plots() that applies a consistent layout, collects duplicate legends and adds automatic panel tags (A, B, C ...), so figures composed from several mp_*() calls look coherent.

Usage

mp_combine(
  ...,
  ncol = NULL,
  nrow = NULL,
  guides = c("collect", "keep", "auto"),
  tag.levels = "A",
  title = NULL,
  subtitle = NULL,
  caption = NULL,
  widths = NULL,
  heights = NULL,
  interactive = FALSE
)

Arguments

...

ggplot objects, or a single named list of them.

ncol, nrow

Grid dimensions (passed to patchwork::wrap_plots()).

guides

How to treat legends: "collect" (default), "keep" or "auto".

tag.levels

Panel-tag style passed to patchwork::plot_annotation(), e.g. "A", "a", "1". Use NULL for no tags.

title, subtitle, caption

Optional figure-level annotations.

widths, heights

Optional relative panel sizes.

interactive

If TRUE, return an interactive plotly subplot instead of a static patchwork (requires plotly). Panel tags and figure-level annotations are not carried over by the conversion.

Value

A patchwork object, or a plotly widget when interactive = TRUE.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
a <- mp_alpha(ps, group.by = "Group")
o <- mp_ordination(ps, group.by = "Group")
mp_combine(a, o, ncol = 2, tag.levels = "A")
} # }
